Ballots recorded by earlier releases read unchanged. Every published site (ic-git, ic-vote, ic-git-loader, ic-git-extension, ic-git-extension-firefox) still verifies after the upgrade

deployed.note: upgrade from v0.3.3, after tools/e2e-local.sh passed 120/120 on this commit including an upgrade from v0.3.3 over state it wrote. The canister crate changed in #69: governed app canisters (docs/GOVERNANCE.md section 2, docs/TENANCY.md). govern_app_canister(repo) makes this canister the app canister's only controller, owner only and one-way; the policy locks with it -- set_required_votes, voter changes, transfer_repo, set_wasm_deploy and set_deploy_mode refuse, required votes never 0 -- and propose_policy_change casts a ballot on the change itself under the commit rule, applied when reached. Every install into a governed app canister publishes <repo>#app (commit, module sha256) to the registry. /api/<repo>/info reports governed; /api/<repo>/proposals lists pending changes. Metadata written by earlier releases reads with governed = false and no proposals. Every published site (ic-git, ic-vote, ic-git-loader, ic-git-extension, ic-git-extension-firefox) still verifies after the upgrade
